cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 provide useful instructions without artificial resistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts the second newly learned setting into a longstanding guest-tailoring method.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee machine and B2 specific controls make the interaction playable.
